headline: South Korea Household Credits Reach 2,030.5 Trillion Won in Q3 2026
summary: Total household credits outstanding in South Korea increased by 9.8 trillion won in the third quarter of 2026 to stand at 2,030.5 trillion won as of the end of September.
why: Household debt levels are a critical indicator for central banks assessing financial stability and consumer credit health.

impacts.name: South Korea Household Credit
impacts.why: Official data shows total household credits increased during the third quarter.
